description: Building-material pools: KL201 without clients mod, KL334 for an unknown own material, another mod's without the dependency, the same material twice, a roof material in a wall pool (own and game), a terrain material, and a blueprint naming no pool, another mod's pool without the dependency or a pool of the other roof kind; the schema's 1 to 64 entries. A dependency's material or pool, and the clean roof pool, say nothing.

diagnostics.message: building material "ice" needs "clients": "mod", and this mod says "kiln": cells reach players as ids, so kiln.worldtables refuses it
building material pool "walls" needs "clients": "mod", and this mod says "kiln": every player's game must list the same pool, so kiln.worldtables refuses it
pool "walls", materials[2] (material other:mud): the material is mod other's, which this mod does not declare in "dependencies"
pool "walls", materials[3] (material nothere): this mod has no building material "nothere"
pool "walls", materials[4] (material slate): a roof material in a wall pool; roof must agree
pool "walls", materials[5] (gameMaterial TerrainStone): a terrain material; a pool lists building materials
pool "walls", materials[6] (gameMaterial RoofStraw): a game roof block in a wall pool; roof must agree
pool "walls", materials[7] (material ice) names the same material as materials[0]: a pool lists each block once
an empty list: give at least one entry
blueprint "roof-on-walls" is a roof shape and materialPool "walls" a wall pool; roof must agree
blueprint "nopool": materialPool "missing" names no pool of this mod's blocks files (a pool another mod defines is "<mod>:<key>", with that mod in "dependencies")
blueprint "foreign": materialPool "other:walls" is mod other's, which this mod does not declare in "dependencies"
